outputs.explanation: Spatial plots show each individual spot's deconvolution score as a colored point on the tissue image; this is raw per-spot data, not an average, so no separate display of individual points is needed.
The box plots showing median/quartile fraction-of-cells values for each immune population also display individual data points (dots for each spatial spot) overlaid on the boxes.
GSEA enrichment plots show a running enrichment score curve and rank statistics (NES, FDR, P), not an averaged summary statistic across replicates, so individual data points are not applicable.

The bar graph shows a single computed log2 fold-change value per gene from a differential expression analysis, not a mean of multiple independent replicate measurements, so individual data points are not required.
Panel E consists of representative H&E and IHC micrographs, not a plot of averaged quantitative data.
